text:
sara: FYI i pushed the kernel-bucket rebalancing last night. saw an uptick in host-side work for short requests in staging.
ian: saw that in traces too. any idea whether it's parsing or socket churn? quick numbers?
priyanka: grabbed perf/strace on a repro pod:
```
# top of stack samples
host_accept_loop -> parse_request -> preparse_split -> writev -> epoll_wait
syscalls: writev increased ~2.3x, sendmsg ~1.1x
host_parse time: 3.9ms (baseline 1.0ms)
fragments emitted per req: 3.1 (baseline 1.2)
```
seems like earlier splitting in preparse is creating more tiny frames.
sara: that's what i feared. kernel selector moved lots of 40-150 token requests into the "wide window" kernels that change ingress framing heuristics.
ian: kv cache telemetry also shows more misses for those requests right after the deploy window. kvcache_hit_rate dropped ~4.8% in staging.
obs-bot: alert fired: kvcache.hit_rate.delta = -4.8% over 10m on staging-cluster (svc=runtime-ingress)
priyanka: digging traces: when preparse splits earlier we lose prefix coalescing and prefixes end up in separate shards so kv lookups miss. that plus more small writes spikes host CPU and syscall overhead.
sara: options: 1) revert kernel-bucket change 2) force preparse.coalesce=true for buckets <160 tokens 3) adjust kernel selector to prefer narrow-window kernels for small seqs.
ian: i prototyped (2) locally. config patch: 
```
{"preparse.coalesce.small_buckets": true, "kernel_selector.small_threshold": 160}
```
Result: fragments per req back to 1.3, host_parse ~1.1ms, kvcache hit recovered ~+3.9%.
priyanka: nice. any throughput impact? we need to watch batching behavior on heavy QPS.
ian: microbench: no measurable throughput regression for our test QPS (50k rps sim). need canary on vhost-canary.
deploy-bot: rolling config to canary vhost-canary (roll id c-2026-0424-2). ETA 5m.
obs-bot: canary sampling: after 15m (n=3500) -> host p50 improved -5.2ms, p95 -8.7ms; kvcache.hit_rate delta +3.7%.
sara: ok plan: keep kernel change but gate preparse.coalesce for small buckets. add perf-suite microtest for host-path <256 tokens and a kvcache hit delta alert >=3%. also add a release note explaining kernel-selector bucket changes (cc: eng-sre).
priyanka: i'll open the PR to add the perf regression test and the integration test for coalesce flip.
ian: i'll prepare the canary->prod rollout playbook and a quick rollback if we see throughput drop or CPU spike.
sara: thanks. owners: priyanka test PR, ian rollout doc, sara monitor canary for 1h. follow-up in #eng-runtime in 1h. :white_check_mark:
